subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned user facts become a first-class Control UI memory surface, and what storage plus injection contract should OpenClaw own?
rationale: The remaining decision crosses product UX, persistent prompt state, memory ownership, stale-fact handling, and browser write security, so automation cannot safely pick the permanent contract.

options.title: Design First-Class Pinned Facts
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify a dedicated pinned-facts model with diff-preview write-back, freshness labels, and guaranteed injection rules before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Memory Panel
options.body: Treat pinned facts as a subfeature of the broader Control UI memory editor tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/46809.

options.title: Defer To Plugin Slots
options.body: Wait for the Control UI contribution-slot RFC and let a memory/context plugin provide the pinned-facts experience if that boundary wins.

recommendation.title: Design First-Class Pinned Facts
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify a dedicated pinned-facts model with diff-preview write-back, freshness labels, and guaranteed injection rules before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans product/security direction, memory behavior, and Gateway/Control UI contracts, where the history shows adjacent ownership.
